note: Major rail corridors and selected hubs across Japan, not an exhaustive list of local stations. A corridor can require transfers. Shinkansen currently ends at Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto in Hokkaido. Okinawa is a separate monorail network; no rail link to the main islands is drawn.
layoutNote: Approximate geographic positions for a schematic overview. Selected hubs and corridors only; intermediate stops and many local operators are omitted.
